Whole file: -stats + cache API/resolveCodexUrl/resolveCodexWebSocketUrl/parseErrorResponse/extractAccountId/createCodexRequestId/buildBaseCodexHeaders/buildSSEHeaders/buildWebSocketHeaders/codexUsageLimitMessage/resolveCodexServiceTier/applyServiceTierPricing/normalizeCodexStatus. reqwest only. One gap: no WebSocket crate exists in the workspace, so the socket comes from set_web_socket_constructor (None by default). With no constructor connectWebSocket fails with the exact TS message 'WebSocket transport is not available in this runtime', which drives the real fallback path (diagnostic + recordWebSocketFailure + recordWebSocketSseFallback) and then SSE. mapCodexEvents throws via an Arc<Mutex<Option<CodexThrown>>> slot because a Rust stream cannot reject; the caller re-raises it at the same point in the catch boundary.
